description: This file contains unit tests for the RemoveKeySession functionality of the RialtoServerMediaKeySession class, which manages media key sessions. It tests successful removal, failure due to session API issues, and failure when an error callback is invoked during removal.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionRemoveKeySessionTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing RemoveKeySession functionality in media key sessions.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Tests that RemoveKeySession successfully removes a session when the underlying API returns OK.

methods.name: OcdmSessionFailure
methods.description: Tests that RemoveKeySession fails when the underlying session API returns NOT_SUPPORTED.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Tests that RemoveKeySession fails if an error is triggered via onError during the removal process.
